title: Invoice to payment matching for one selected vendor
prompt: For a selected vendor, match every invoice this year to its payment(s). Flag split payments, overpayments, possible duplicate payments and payments coded to different accounts.

setup.q: Which vendor should be matched (name or vendor id)?
Which payment methods does this vendor get paid by (ACH, check, wire, card)?

steps: resolve the vendor in Dime and pull this year's bills and bill payments for it, plus bank and card outflows to the vendor not applied to a bill
match each invoice to its payment(s) by reference, then by amount and date; list invoices paid by more than one payment (split) and payments covering more than one invoice
list overpayments (payments above the invoice), unpaid invoices and payments with no invoice
run duplicate_pairs over the payments (same amount within 30 days) for possible duplicate payments
compare the expense account on each invoice with the vendor's usual account and list payments coded elsewhere
tie: invoices less payments equals the vendor's open balance in Dime

done.text: Every exception row cites the invoice id and the payment id
vendor-invoice-payment-match.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Every invoice shows its payment(s); split payments, overpayments, possible duplicates and different coding are separate exception types with a reason each
